convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iRSI, iBands). Simple entry/exit rules with fixed pips SL/TP. Standard position sizing. No external .mqh libraries. No grid, martingale, or hedging logic.

derived_values.name: RSI value used as input to Bollinger Bands calculation

other_exits: Close long position when short signal fires, close short position when long signal fires

custom_logic_notes: Bollinger Bands are applied to the RSI indicator values, not to price directly. The EA computes RSI first, then applies Bollinger Bands to the RSI series. Entry signals use previous bar values (shift=1) for RSI vs BB band crossovers to avoid repainting. SL/TP values in pips are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to normalize for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: The Bollinger Bands must be computed on the RSI series, not on price. Use ta-lib or pandas-ta: first compute RSI(14) on close prices, then compute Bollinger Bands(14, 2) on the RSI values. Ensure SL/TP pip values account for 5-digit broker normalization (multiply by 10 when point < 0.001). Entry signals use previous completed bar (shift=1) to match MT5's IsNewBar + previous bar signal pattern. Position check ensures only one position at a time before opening a new trade.
